ACTIVITY BY HOUR

A connection means movement was observed between two spatial cells in the sampled records. It is not a road geometry or proof of the exact route taken.

Accessible edge table

METHOD

From delivery records to a network

01

Start with an event

Each LaDe-D record identifies a package, courier, delivery location, and task-event times. Acceptance and delivery GPS coordinates provide the two ends of a movement.

02

Aggregate space

Coordinates are grouped into small spatial cells. Cells become nodes; repeated movement between the same pair becomes a weighted directed edge.

03

Inspect patterns

Node size reveals delivery concentration and edge thickness reveals repeated movement. Filters let you narrow the sampled records.

PROJECT CONTEXT

Urban transportation through a package-delivery network

Domain: Urban transportation / last-mile logistics.

Data: Cainiao-AI/LaDe-D, with package, courier, AOI, location, and task-event attributes across five cities.

Network: Nodes represent spatial delivery areas; directed weighted edges summarize observed package movement between locations.

Idiom: Node-link.

Why this view: It makes hubs, repeated connections, and spatial concentration easier to inspect than a flat table of package records.

Limits: This website uses a small sample for interactive exploration. A network edge is an observed relationship in the records, not a traffic count, route trace, or performance guarantee.
